diff --git a/.github/workflows/px1-agentic-review.yml b/.github/workflows/px1-agentic-review.yml
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..93f95fb
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/px1-agentic-review.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,71 @@
+name: px1 agentic review
+
+# px1 reviews its own pull requests with its own agentic reviewer. The reviewer
+# that holds OPENAI_API_KEY is built from the BASE commit, never from the pull
+# request, so a pull request cannot change the code that sees the key. The
+# pull request is checked out only as data to read.
+#
+# The job does nothing until a repository secret named OPENAI_API_KEY exists,
+# and never runs for pull requests from forks, which get no secrets.
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+  pull-requests: write
+
+concurrency:
+  group: px1-agentic-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+
+jobs:
+  review:
+    if: github.event.pull_request.draft == false && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 15
+    continue-on-error: true # a failed review must never block a merge
+    env:
+      OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
+    steps:
+      - name: Check for the API key
+        id: key
+        run: |
+          if [[ -z "$OPENAI_API_KEY" ]]; then
+            echo "::notice title=px1 agentic review skipped::add an OPENAI_API_KEY repository secret to enable it"
+            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          else
+            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          fi
+
+      - name: Check out the pull request (data only)
+        if: steps.key.outputs.present == 'true'
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          fetch-depth: 0
+          persist-credentials: false
+
+      - name: Check out the reviewer from the base commit
+        if: steps.key.outputs.present == 'true'
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
+          path: .px1-tool
+          persist-credentials: false
+
+      - name: Review
+        if: steps.key.outputs.present == 'true'
+        uses: ./.px1-tool/agentic-action
+        with:
+          model: gpt-6-luna
+          price-input: '0.10'
+          price-output: '0.50'
+          price-cached-input: '0.01'
+          max-cost: '0.50'
+          exclude-globs: |
+            dist/**
+            dist-npm/**
+            launch-film/**
+            output/**
+            tmp/**
+            web/dashboard/**/package-lock.json

blocks.summary: 3 related files share the "agentic" change signal.

explanations.title: Adds automatic reviews for eligible pull requests
explanations.summary: The workflow reviews eligible pull requests when they are opened, updated, reopened, or marked ready. It skips drafts, fork pull requests, and runs without an `OPENAI_API_KEY` secret.

explanations.title: Keeps reviews bounded and non-blocking
explanations.summary: A new run for the same pull request cancels an older run, and review failures do not block merging. The job also has a 15-minute timeout.

explanations.title: Runs the reviewer from trusted base code
explanations.summary: The pull request checkout is used as review input, while the action that runs is checked out from the base commit. This prevents pull request changes from replacing the reviewer code that receives the API key.

explanations.title: Limits review cost and scope
explanations.summary: The reviewer is configured with a $0.50 maximum cost and excludes several generated or large directories from review.
